title: Wireless Redstone Networking in Minecraft
description:
We return to the wonderful world of wireless redstone where we take a deep dive into sending wireless binary signals within redstone telemetry networks. Wow, that is a lot of technical language, be sure to check out the video to learn all about Binary encoded wireless redstone in minecraft.
